purpose: additional live full-planner sequences (6-10) beyond the frozen 5 (1-5), same unmodified gate/detector/formulation, to test whether an accepted relocation occurs under more trials
finding: All 5 replan opportunities across the 5 new sequences were rejected by the unmodified economic gate, with net_benefit deterministically -9567.33 whenever the persistent-degradation regime triggered a replan (the R1 condition->scenario mapping is fixed per condition label, not randomized per sequence seed, so new sequences replicate rather than resample the underlying economics). Combined with the original 5 sequences / 7 replans (all rejected), this is 10 sequences / 12 replan opportunities total, all rejected -- a robust, reproducible negative result rather than a fluke of the original 5-sequence sample.
